standard_prerequisites.use: The quasi-projective five-way equivalence (lemma-quasi-projective, collected as L16072); the Morphisms-chapter base change and permanence lemmas for quasi-projective morphisms; the chapter's quasi-finite-separated-quasi-affine theorem (Zariski Main Type corollary).

core_obligations: Verify the categorical closures from the characterization lemmas.
Check each source class against the dictionary of Morphisms/chapter results.

proof_roadmap.step: Base change and composition closures via the fourth/fifth characterizations.
Source-class inclusions via the quasi-affine and quasi-finite machinery.

difficulty_reason: For a base scheme S with an ample invertible sheaf, the full subcategory QP_S of schemes over S satisfying the quasi-projective equivalent conditions (lemma-quasi-projective) is shown closed under: base change along maps of ample-invertible-sheaf bases, composition, fibre products, finite disjoint unions, and contains every projective S-scheme, every finite type quasi-affine S-scheme, every quasi-finite separated S-scheme, and every quasi-compact immersion into S; the statement list ends with the author's own placeholder item add more here retained verbatim. The retained proof is written part by part: (1) is Morphisms, lemma base-change-quasi-projective; (2) is the fourth characterization of lemma-quasi-projective; (3) combines (1) and (2); (4) uses the fifth characterization plus the standard fact that a line bundle ample on both pieces of a disjoint union is ample (details omitted by the author for that one-line sheaf argument); (5) is Morphisms, lemma projective-quasi-projective; (6) is Morphisms, lemma quasi-affine-finite-type-quasi-projective; (7) combines (6) with chapter lemma quasi-finite-separated-quasi-affine; (8) combines (7) with Morphisms, lemma immersion-locally-quasi-finite. Retained author proof at lines 13916-13954.
